CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

2. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
